lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Goku, what have you done?! You've blasted off into space!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: You're incredibly lucky I already set the coordinates for Namek, but you... you...

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Where did you get that muffin?

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: But... I... never installed a Muffin Button!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Then where did I get this muffin...?

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Whatever you do, don't fool with the gravity controls. It goes up to 100 times Earth's normal gravity.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So what you're saying is: If I turn up the gravity, then I can get stronger!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: NO! What I'm saying is it will crush your bones!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: The detrimental effects could be catastrophic! You may never walk again!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Bored now. Gotta train. Bye bye!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Yeah. Little bastards just hit me outta nowhere.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Oh, trust me. I know what it's like to take a hard one to the face.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Good to see you're still conscious, Dodoria.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, and just so you know, it's not a big deal or anything, you might want to get right onto this one, but THEY'RE GETTING AWAY, YOU FAT BASTARD!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Not gonna lie, Gohan; not your brightest move.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, come on, Krillin; we have a two mile lead on him.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Factoring in our speed and velocity and his mass, there's no way he should be able to catch up--

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: How do you think Dodoria is doing up there?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: We're talking about one of my finest soldiers.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: There's no way that they'll escape Dodoria's grasp.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: But what if they have any tricks up their sleeves?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Come now, Zarbon! We both know Dodoria would never let them out of sight.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Still sir, we have to remember that Vegeta is on the planet.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, please! Like Vegeta could even lay a hand on Dodoria!

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Vegeta! You got some serious balls to get the drop on me!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Funny you should mention that. I just happen to be looking for a set.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Well, look at you, Veggie. All grown up and out on your own, trying to move up in the world.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And look at you, packing away more bacon than Hormel.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Very funny. But you won't be laughing when Freeza finds your scrawny ass.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: So how about I make you a deal:

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: You hand over that pretty red Scouter, and maybe I won't point Freeza in the right direction.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, I'd be inclined to give it to you; but, you see, there's a problem with it.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Blagh!!! You fool! Now you're as blind as the rest of us!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Not quite. See, while I was on Earth, I learned a new trick.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: How the hell'd you do that?

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Wait a minute...! I get it now! Those little bastards I were chasing were Earthlings!

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: You sent them to lure me away from Freeza!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'm sorry, but at this point, all I hear is: "Hit me, Vegeta!" "Please kill me!" "God, this armor makes me look fat!"

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Any last words before I take you apart like a pink Potato Head?

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: W-W-Wait! I can tell you what really happened to your planet!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You mean that Freeza blew it up?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Really should have told Freeza to keep off the Twitter.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: Ple-e-ease, do-hon't kill me, I beg ya, DON'T KILL MEE-EE-EE-ee-ee-eeeee...!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Look at you, Dodoria... you were always so damn proud... and now here you are, CRYING like a woman!

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: I SAID I AM A WOMAN!!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Welp! Good thing I was there to get us out of that one!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, yeah, but, why didn't you use your Kienzan--?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: HEY LOOK! I even saved this thing. Can you fly, little guy?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: My name is Dende. And yes; we all learn when we are children.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You know, you should probably stick with us.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Considering it is either that, or going back to meet the same fate as my brother and father... I am weighing my options.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I like you! I'm gonna call you Little Green!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Come on, Little Green! Let's go introduce you to Bulma!

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: ...and that's why I was considered the most beautiful, and fertile, woman on my home planet.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: He tends to do that. Also, huuuughhh!

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: So now you know the truth, Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yes, I do. And now I'm going to start repressing the truth!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And the first step... is killing you.

lines.speaker: Dodoria
lines.text: You and I, w-we could team up against Freeza! Rule the universe - as husband and wife!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey Bulma, you clean up in there? We have guests.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I do not think I want to go in there.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Awww, don't worry. That's just Bulma.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I do not know what this "Bulma" is, but it sounds needy.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, if it isn't Mr. Super Soaker himself!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: What happened? Got tired of abandoning me and found something else to abandon?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I am still weighing my options...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, by the way, my Dad called earlier.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: He says Goku's on his way here!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: And he'll be here in six days.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well....good thing I took out that life insurance policy.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Mr. Gohan? Those things on that person's chest... what are they?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, on Bulma? Those are breasts.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: They look lovely. I wish to nestle between them...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh-- no, no Ginyu, we don't need any assistance. We have this all under control.

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Lord Freeza, I wish to enter.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh pardon me, I have to take this. Ta ta!

lines.speaker: Zarbon
lines.text: Well, sir, the Scouters reported back.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Gooooood; so Dodoria has eliminated those pests then?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now... before I start training, I need the right music to train to!

segments.title: The Muffin Button
segments.quote: Muffin Button. / But... I... never installed a Muffin Button! / Then where did I get this muffin...?

segments.title: Bored Now. Gotta Train.
segments.quote: If I turn up the gravity, then I can get stronger! / NO! What I'm saying is it will crush your bones!

segments.title: 'Sup, Bubblegum?
segments.quote: 'Sup, Bubblegum? / And look at you, packing away more bacon than Hormel.

segments.title: It's Broken
segments.quote: It's broken. / I can sense energy. / How the hell'd you do that? / I dunno.

segments.title: All I Hear Is 'Hit Me, Vegeta!'
segments.quote: "Hit me, Vegeta!" "Please kill me!" "God, this armor makes me look fat!"

segments.title: THATFREEZABLEWITUP!!!
segments.quote: You mean that Freeza blew it up? / NO! THATFREEZABLEWITUP!!!

segments.title: I AM A WOMAN!!!
segments.quote: And now here you are, CRYING like a woman! / I AM A WOMAN!!!! / ...WHAT?!

segments.title: Little Green
segments.quote: My name is Dende. / I like you! I'm gonna call you Little Green!

segments.title: ...Aaaaaand Repressed
segments.quote: And the first step... is killing you. / Repressing in 5... 4... 3... 2... 1...!! / ...aaaaaand repressed.

segments.title: It Turns Out... She's Dead
segments.quote: It turns out... she's dead. / ...THE F**K?!

segments.title: The Right Music to Train To
